title: The Wire: The parable of the bowls of shit.
summary: A clip from The Wire (season 4, episode 7) in which a former mayor tells Tommy Carcetti about having to "eat shit" from each constituency during his term. It is a parable about the unpleasant compromises of political leadership.
why: Cited as a parable that leaders must absorb criticism and do the unpleasant work nobody else will.

quote.text: regardless of the size of the organization, its leaders are the ones who must deal with the stuff no one else can or wants to tackle.
